instructions:
1. Attach the band to a high anchor point. Stand facing away from the anchor, holding a handle in each hand.
2. Stagger your stance with one foot forward, both knees slightly bent.
3. Start with elbows bent and hands at chest height.
4. Press the handles forward and down in a diagonal line until your arms are straight near your hips.
5. Return to the start under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you press, inhale as you return.
2. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning forward.
3. Squeeze your chest at the bottom of the press.
4. Move slowly and avoid using momentum.
name: Chest press high to low cable Resistance band

instructions:
1. Attach the band to a low anchor point. Stand facing away from the anchor, holding a handle in each hand.
2. Stagger your stance with one foot forward, both knees slightly bent.
3. Start with elbows bent and hands near your chest sides.
4. Press the handles forward and up in a diagonal line until your arms are straight at shoulder height.
5. Return to the start under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you press, inhale as you return.
2. Keep your torso upright and avoid leaning back.
3. Drive the press from your upper chest.
4. Move slowly and avoid using momentum.
name: Chest press low to high Resistance band

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and lean slightly forward at the hips.
2. Hold both arms in front of your chest, palms facing each other.
3. Pull your right arm back, bending the elbow and squeezing your shoulder blade toward your spine.
4. Return your right arm to the front while keeping your left arm steady.
5. Switch arms and repeat the pull on the other side.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine at the end of each pull.
2. Move slowly and avoid using momentum.
3. Keep your shoulders down and away from your ears.
4. Exhale as you pull back, inhale as you return.
name: Chest pull back

instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
2. Bend your elbows to 90 degrees with forearms parallel to the floor and elbows tucked to your sides.
3. Rotate your forearms upward and outward until they point toward the ceiling and your upper arms reach shoulder level.
4. Reverse the motion back to the starting position.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your elbows bent at 90 degrees throughout the movement.
2. Move slowly to control the rotation and protect your shoulders.
3. Keep your shoulder blades down and back.
4. Breathe steadily, exhaling as you rotate up.
name: Chest raise and rotate

instructions:
1. Kneel on all fours with knees under your hips and hands under your shoulders.
2. Place your right forearm on an exercise ball to your side, elbow bent at 90 degrees.
3. Lower your chest toward the floor until you feel a stretch across the front of your chest.
4. Hold the position.
5. Return to the start and switch sides.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lower only as far as is comfortable and do not force the stretch.
2. Move slowly into and out of the stretch.
3. Relax your chest and shoulder to deepen the stretch.
4. Keep your hips aligned over your knees for a stable base.
name: Chest stretch with exercise ball
